champion-ep.description: If your Hitpoints dip below 20% a healing item is used (if present) otherwise you attack.
champion-ep.name: Champion EP

conjurer.description: Cast Illusion in first round then Attempt to Drain or Damage the enemy, attack if out of mana.
conjurer.name: Conjurer

damage-bot.description: Randomly choose a target and cast damage spells on them.
damage-bot.name: Damage Bot

debuff-spell-caster.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a debuff spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% cast a spell on target otherwise try to Heal self with spell.
debuff-spell-caster.name: Debuff Spell Caster

dot-spell-caster.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a dot spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% cast a spell on target otherwise try to Heal self using an item (food/potion).
dot-spell-caster.name: DOT Spell Caster

drain-script-health.description: Attempt to mana item if mana below 20%, otherwise if Hitpoints is over 10% cast drain spells otherwise attack with melee.
drain-script-health.name: Drain Script (Health)

drain-script-mana.description: Attempt to Drain or Damage the enemy, attack if out of mana.
drain-script-mana.name: Drain Script (Mana)

drain-script-melee.description: Attempt to mana item if mana below 20%, otherwise if Hitpoints is over 50% use melee, otherwise use drain magic.
drain-script-melee.name: Drain Script (Melee)

druid-no-shield.description: Iif Hitpoints are over 20% cast a damage spell on target otherwise try to Heal self with spell.
druid-no-shield.name: Druid no Shield

druid-with-shield.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a shield spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% cast a damage spell on target otherwise try to Heal self with spell.
druid-with-shield.name: Druid with Shield

generic-caster-script.description: If you have the mana a damage spell is cast, otherwise a heal spell or an attack is used.
generic-caster-script.name: Generic Caster Script

generic-fighter-script.description: If your Hitpoints dip below 20% a healing item is used (if present) otherwise you attack.
generic-fighter-script.name: Generic Fighter Script

generic-ranged-caster-script.description: If you have the mana a damage spell is cast, otherwise a heal spell or an attack is used.
generic-ranged-caster-script.name: Generic Ranged Caster Script

generic-ranged-script.description: If your Hitpoints dip below 20% a healing item is used (if present) otherwise you attack using range.
generic-ranged-script.name: Generic Ranged Script

guardian-ep.description: If your Hitpoints dip below 20% a healing item is used (if present) otherwise you attack.
guardian-ep.name: Guardian EP

heal-bot.description: Randomly choose an injured party member and heal them. If no one is injured then no action is taken.
heal-bot.name: Heal Bot

healer-script.description: If your Mana drops below 20% a mana item is used (if present) otherwise if your Health is above 30% a drain spell is used otherwise a Heal spell is used or an Attack.
healer-script.name: Healer Script

illusion-spell-caster.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast an Illusion spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% cast a spell on target otherwise try to Heal self with spell.
illusion-spell-caster.name: Illusion Spell Caster

illusion-spell-melee.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast an Illusion spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% use melee otherwise try to Use heal food.
illusion-spell-melee.name: Illusion Spell Melee

minstrel-ranged-script.description: If your Hitpoints dip below 20% a healing item is used (if present) otherwise you attack using range.
minstrel-ranged-script.name: Minstrel Ranged Script

mystic-drain-damage.description: If Level 300 then cast a drain spell on target, otherwise if health is over 20% cast a damage spell on target, otherwise cast a heal spell on self.
mystic-drain-damage.name: Mystic (Drain / Damage)

paralyse-spell-caster.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a paralyse spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% cast a spell on target otherwise try to Heal self with spell.
paralyse-spell-caster.name: Paralyse Spell Caster

paralyse-spell-melee.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a paralyse spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% use melee otherwise try to Use heal food.
paralyse-spell-melee.name: Paralyse Spell Melee

shield-spell-caster.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a shield spell, then in subsequent rounds if Mana is over 20% cast a spell on target otherwise try to drain enemies mana with spell.
shield-spell-caster.name: Shield Spell Caster

shield-spell-melee.description: If this is the first round attempt to cast a shield spell, then in subsequent rounds if Hitpoints are over 20% use melee otherwise try to Use heal food.
shield-spell-melee.name: Shield Spell Melee

trap-use-traps-skill-req.description: Attempts to use a Trap from your Inventory, you need the Traps skill and a trap made with Inventory > Tradeskill > Traps for this to work.
trap-use-traps-skill-req.name: Trap Use (Traps skill req)

undead-nuker.description: Randomly choose a target and cast damage spells on them.
undead-nuker.name: Undead Nuker
